name: Odette
notes: A Cryo Stellar-Conduct sub-DPS and support that scales with ATK on the elemental curve. Her Skill is the talent that matters (KQM: Skill far above everything; Game8: Skill, Burst, Normal Attack), so the damage talent is the Skill. The sources agree on 4pc Heart of the Furnace as best with Disenchantment in Deep Shadow as the alternative (KQM: damage-oriented for Stellar-Conduct teams), ATK% on the Sands and Goblet, a CRIT Circlet (Game8: CRIT Rate before CRIT DMG) and Whitelake Frostfeather first. The third and fourth sets are KQM's placeholders. Goals are Game8's: ATK 2,000-3,000 (upper end), CRIT Rate 50-60%, CRIT DMG 180% or above, ER 125-145%; KQM's ER ranges from 100% to 220% by team and Cryo count. Game8's EM of 150-200 is not set.
